regions.cleaned_text: God bless you and yours. Many thanks for the air mail yesterday. Glad to hear things are improving with your dear Dad. Thanks be to God for everything. I am sending you the mourning card for Wm. Murphy and the certifi- cates-blanks-for the two others. Not certain of their names I just made a special enrollment ($1.00 or more) for each of two according to your intention. You can fill out the blanks, etc. Dear Muriel: .... You tell me you see others so happy .... O! yes we see such people. Thank God they exist, though many of those who seem happy-who try to appear so-hardly know just what happiness is. Many do not realiz or stop to use their faculty of reasoning that the very soul of happiness for mortals-those who are to die some day-is hope. Children are happy as a rule because in the mind of any normal child "Some day I'll be grown up." Herein we must imitate the child- there is always bright star of hope: "I'll be a woman." "I'll be a man." ren. But instead of their ideals to be mature-a man or woman-we ought to think over to goal ahead, our eternal destiny-for all Eternity- to be proficient in what in this world we can only taste, so to say Know- ledge of God. Knowledge of anyone who is good means love for same in- as much as we be normal. Knowledge of God, therefore !!!! The aim, the purpose of the rational creature's existence.
